description:
System Rename
Rename the systems you have made your own.

Source code | Changelog and older versions

Required mods: None
Adding to an ongoing game: Safe
Updating: Safe
Removing from an ongoing game: Safe

What is this?
System Rename is a small quality-of-life mod that lets you rename procedurally generated star systems and their stars after establishing yourself as the dominant colonial power in the system.

Once your colonies hold the largest combined population share in a procedurally generated system, speak to an administrator, station commander, or portmaster at one of your colonies to officially rename it.

Rename procedurally generated systems through normal colony interactions.
Rename individual stars within eligible systems.
Population-based ownership means you need the largest combined colonial population in the system before renaming it. Ties do not qualify.
Story systems are protected and cannot be renamed.
Internal system and star IDs are unchanged. Only their displayed names are modified.

How to use

Have at least one player-owned colony in a procedurally generated system.
Your colonies must hold the largest combined population share in that system. Ties do not qualify.
Contact an administrator, station commander, or portmaster at one of your colonies.
Choose Discuss the system's official designation.
Choose the system or star you want to rename and enter the new name.

The suffixes are preserved automatically.

Installation

See Adding mods to your game: first steps

Download and extract System Rename.
Place the SystemRename folder inside your Starsector mods folder.
Enable System Rename in the Starsector launcher.

Updating: Updating from an older version should be safe. A clean replacement of the old mod folder is recommended.

Known compatibility issues: None currently known.

The mod changes the displayed names of eligible systems and stars, but does not change their internal IDs.

FAQ
Which systems can I rename?
Only procedurally generated systems can be renamed. Story-protected systems are excluded.

Why can I not rename a system where I have a colony?
Your colonies must hold the largest combined population share in that system. If another faction has an equal or larger population share, the rename option will not be available.

Where is the rename option?
Speak to an administrator, station commander, or portmaster at one of your colonies and select "Discuss the system's official designation".

Can I rename individual stars?
Yes. Individual stars in eligible procedurally generated systems can be renamed.

Can I rename a binary or multi-star system all at once?
Yes. Version 1.0.2 adds a combined rename option when all stars use the standard A-F suffix naming convention. Their letter suffixes are preserved automatically.

Will renaming a system break references from other mods?
System Rename changes the displayed names but does not change system or star IDs. Mods that refer to them by their internal IDs should therefore continue to refer to the same objects.

Can I add or remove this mod during an ongoing campaign?
Yes. The mod does not add campaign entities that a save depends on. Renamed systems and stars use the existing game objects rather than replacing their IDs.

Attribution and permissions
Author: Mirarara

Code permissions: Do whatever you want with it.

You are welcome to reuse, modify, fork, redistribute, maintain, or update the code for your own projects.

Credit is appreciated, but not required.

If I stop maintaining the mod and somebody wants to take it over, feel free to do so.

AI use disclaimer
This mod was implemented with the assistance of GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI was used to assist with implementation of the mod's code and functionality.

I reviewed and tested the resulting implementation and made changes where necessary.

Version history
1.0.2

Added an option to rename a multi-star system and all of its stars together.
The combined rename option is only shown when every star follows the standard A-F letter suffix convention.

1.0.1

Updated the version file for automatic update checking.

Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are welcome.

For bug reports, please include your Starsector version, System Rename version, enabled mods, and steps to reproduce the problem. A relevant starsector.log or screenshot also helps.
